provenance.shape-is-a-literal-not-a-density-token: RadioButtonIcon.css `border-radius: 50%` — a PLAIN LITERAL, unlike checkbox's box (`corner-weaker`) or switch's thumb (`corner-weaker`) — a radio glyph is always a perfect circle regardless of density, so there is no `corner-*`/`curve-*` token involved at all, confirmed by reading the whole file for any `border-radius` reference beyond this one line.
provenance.border-width-fixed: RadioButtonIcon.css `border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) ...` -> foundations/size.css --salt-size-fixed-100: 1px, FIXED (density-invariant) scale, the same convention checkbox's/switch's own border-width rows used.
provenance.no-pressed-state: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly: neither RadioButton.css nor RadioButtonIcon.css nor RadioButtonGroup.css contains any `:active` selector.
provenance.no-transition: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: none of the three .css files declares a `transition` property anywhere.
provenance.no-touch-target: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: no separate touch-target/hit-area element or token exists anywhere in this component family — the item's own visible box IS its hit area.
provenance.no-arrow-key-js: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly: RadioButton.tsx and RadioButtonGroup.tsx bind no keydown handler of any kind — accessibility.mdx's documented arrow-key behaviour is entirely native browser semantics for same-name sibling `<input type="radio">` elements.
provenance.readonly-caveat: RadioButtonProps.readOnly's own JSDoc, quoted directly: 'Setting a standalone radio button as read-only is not accessible. The whole radio button group should be set as read-only instead.'
provenance.required-implicit: @salt-ds/core's own RadioButtonGroup usage.mdx PropsTable references shared documentation for `required` reachable only through `inputProps.required` on RadioButtonProps, the same indirect shape checkbox's and switch's own Salt columns already used.
provenance.selection-comparison: RadioButton.tsx: `const radioGroupChecked = checkedProp ?? (radioGroup && value ? radioGroup.value === value : checkedProp)` — a GROUP-held string `value` compared against each item's own `value` prop, the exact mechanism behavior.selection-model cites.
provenance.three-way-disabled-merge: RadioButton.tsx: `const disabled = radioGroup?.disabled || formFieldDisabled || disabledProp` — group, ancestor form-field, and own prop, all three merged with OR.

structure.group.source: RadioButtonGroup.tsx returns <fieldset role="radiogroup" aria-readonly={readOnly} ...>, providing RadioGroupContext to children

structure.shell.source: RadioButton.tsx returns <label className=saltRadioButton>{input}{RadioButtonIcon}{label}</label> — one real <label>, matching Checkbox.tsx's own shape exactly

structure.native-input.source: RadioButton.tsx <input type="radio" className={withBaseName("input")} ... /> — a real native input, opacity:0, position:absolute (RadioButton.css)

structure.dot.source: RadioButtonIcon.tsx: {checked && !readOnly && <solid filled-circle svg>} {checked && readOnly && <lighter donut-ring svg>} — the identical readOnly-glyph-swap mechanism CheckboxIcon.tsx/Switch's icon already used

behavior.role.value: implicit — role=radio from the native <input type="radio">, no explicit role attribute anywhere
behavior.role.source: RadioButton.tsx — no role prop written; the native input type supplies it for free, the same free-role mechanism checkbox's own column used

behavior.group-role.value: explicit role="radiogroup" on the <fieldset>, plus aria-readonly reflecting the group's own readOnly

behavior.keyboard-select.value: Space activates the focused radio if not already checked (native); no keydown override
behavior.keyboard-select.source: accessibility.mdx: "If the focused radio button isn't checked, Space changes the state to checked"; no onKeyDown in RadioButton.tsx

behavior.arrow-navigation.value: native — Up/Down/Left/Right move focus AND selection between same-name sibling inputs, entirely free from the browser
behavior.arrow-navigation.source: accessibility.mdx: "This action moves focus between the available radio button options, and simultaneously selects an option"; see no-arrow-key-js

behavior.selection-model.value: a GROUP-held string value compared against each item's own value prop, shared via RadioGroupContext

behavior.disabled-handling.value: native disabled on the input, a THREE-WAY merge of group/form-field/own prop, plus a blanket opacity class on the whole label

behavior.readonly.value: implemented in JS at BOTH item and group level and merged, NOT relying on the (spec-inert) native readonly attribute; own JSDoc recommends group-level readOnly over item-level

behavior.label-click-target.value: the WHOLE label — dot and text both toggle it

behavior.form-participation.value: native — the input IS the real form control
behavior.form-participation.source: a real <input type="radio" name=... value=... checked=.../>, no custom validity machinery needed

behavior.validation.value: computed PER ITEM and suppressed when THAT item is disabled

prop.selection-shape.source: RadioButtonGroupProps.value: string, RadioButtonProps.value: string — see prop.selection-shape's row note

prop.disabled.source: RadioButtonProps.disabled?: boolean, merged with the group's

prop.required.note: reachable only via inputProps.required (RadioButtonProps has no top-level required field), see required-implicit

slot.label.value: label?: ReactNode, rendered as the LAST child inside the component's own <label>

slot.composes.note: form-field (useFormFieldProps() pulls aria-describedby/aria-labelledby down from an ancestor <FormField> when NOT inside a RadioButtonGroup), switch/checkbox/dropdown/combo-box (the four explicitly-excluded siblings, usage.mdx)

state.rest.value: neutral gray-500 outline on a white/near-black container fill, never filled solid
state.rest.note: an outline-style item at EVERY state, including checked — see state.checked

state.checked.value: the fill NEVER changes — only the border recolours to accent AND a solid inner circle glyph appears

state.hover.value: item border+icon colour move to the -hover variant, keyed off the item's own :hover

state.focus.value: 2px dotted accent-stronger outline at 1px offset, plus the hover recolour riding along

state.disabled.value: blanket opacity 0.4 on the whole label, plus not-allowed cursor

state.readonly.value: border recolours to a dedicated readonly token AND switches to a dashed style; the glyph itself swaps to a lighter donut-ring svg

style.item.size.note: aliases the item-size density slot for both dimensions

style.item.shape.source: RadioButtonIcon.css border-radius: 50% — a plain literal, see shape-is-a-literal-not-a-density-token

style.item.border-width.source: RadioButtonIcon.css border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid ... = 1px, FIXED scale

style.item.rest.source: RadioButtonIcon.css .saltRadioButtonIcon { border-color: selectable-borderColor; background: container-primary-background; color: selectable-foreground }

style.item.checked.source: RadioButtonIcon.css .saltRadioButtonIcon-checked { border-color: selectable-borderColor-selected; color: selectable-foreground-selected } — no background rule, box-bg UNCHANGED from rest

style.item.hover.source: RadioButtonIcon.css .saltRadioButton:hover .saltRadioButtonIcon — resolves to the SAME accent slot as -checked

style.item.focus.source: RadioButton.css .saltRadioButton-input:focus-visible + .saltRadioButtonIcon { outline: var(--saltRadioButton-outline, var(--salt-focused-outline)); outline-offset: var(--salt-spacing-fixed-100) } = 1px

style.item.readonly.source: RadioButtonIcon.css .saltRadioButtonIcon-readOnly { border-color: selectable-borderColor-readonly; border-style: dashed; color: content-primary-foreground }

style.dot.size.source: Icon component default --saltIcon-size: 100% — fills whatever item it sits in

style.dot.fill.note: the glyph's fill="currentColor" is a literal in markup, inheriting the item's own color property — no separate CSS row needed

style.dot.fill@checked.note: see style.dot.fill — colour already tracks style.item.checked's own color property via currentColor

style.dot.hover.note: already carried by style.item.hover's color, which the dot inherits via currentColor

style.dot.disabled.note: Salt dims the whole item uniformly instead — see style.item.disabled

style.dot.inner-grow@checked.note: structure.dot=conditional-glyph renders no inner/outer circle pair

style.root.font.source: RadioButton.css .saltRadioButton { font-size/line-height/font-family/font-weight: var(--salt-text-*) } — the BODY role, REGULAR (400)
